# Bidspoke

> Bidspoke is a visual workflow builder for lead routing and partner bidding. Users build workflows on a drag-and-drop canvas, trigger them over HTTP, and the engine runs them in real time: validating leads, pulling credit, soliciting bids from partners in parallel, picking a winner, and responding with an offer. This file indexes the platform documentation so an AI assistant can help users build and edit workflows.

Each link points to a raw markdown page. Append nothing; the .md URLs are self-contained. The human-readable site for each page is the same URL without the .md suffix (for example /docs/concepts/overview). To build a workflow definition, read the Workflow definition schema, Data references, and the relevant node pages.

## Start here

- [Documentation home](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/README.md): index of all pages.
- [Overview](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/concepts/overview.md): what Bidspoke is and the two modes (outbound routing, inbound bidding).
- [Getting started](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/guides/getting-started.md): build, save, test, and trigger your first workflow.

## Concepts

- [Workflow definition schema](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/concepts/workflow-definition-schema.md): the canonical JSON shape of a workflow. Read this to build one.
- [Data references](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/concepts/data-references.md): the expression and template syntax (steps.*, trigger.*, env.*).
- [Workflows and executions](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/concepts/workflows-and-executions.md): the core domain model.
- [Triggers and endpoints](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/concepts/triggers-and-endpoints.md): how workflows are invoked over HTTP.
- [Bidding model](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/concepts/bidding-model.md): hub-and-spoke and ping-post bidding, caps, circuit breakers, dedup.
- [Glossary](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/concepts/glossary.md): definitions of every term.

## Nodes

- [Node catalog](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/README.md): all node types, grouped by purpose.
- [Filter](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/filter.md): pass/exit gate on a condition.
- [Branch](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/branch.md): N conditional outputs plus else.
- [Parallel](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/parallel.md): fan out to child nodes concurrently.
- [Exit](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/exit.md): end the execution early.
- [Response](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/response.md): send a structured HTTP response.
- [Code](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/code.md): run a sandboxed JavaScript script.
- [Webhook](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/webhook.md): outbound HTTP request (the Integration node).
- [Salesforce](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/salesforce.md): create, update, or query Salesforce records.
- [Transform](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/transform.md): map and reshape data.
- [Constants](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/constants.md): emit workflow constants plus partner data.
- [Data Store](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/data-store.md): read and write a key-value store.
- [Bid Group](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/bid-group.md): fan out to N partners and pick a winner.
- [Partner Bid](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/partner-bid.md): request a bid from one partner.
- [Bid Evaluation](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/bid-evaluation.md): pick a winner from collected bids.
- [Latency Gate](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/latency-gate.md): mark and check a partner match-latency window.
- [Achieve Offers](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/nodes/achieve-offers.md): send the lead to Achieve (FDR) and log the offers returned.

## Guides

- [Building a bidding workflow](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/guides/building-a-bidding-workflow.md): an end-to-end outbound routing flow.
- [Configuring a partner](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/guides/configuring-a-partner.md): add and configure a bidding partner.
- [Testing and debugging](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/guides/testing-and-debugging.md): the Test Runner, execution overlay, replay, and resume.
- [Environment variables and secrets](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/guides/environment-variables-and-secrets.md): where credentials live and how nodes read them.
- [Versioning and backup](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/guides/versioning-and-backup.md): version snapshots, restore, and GitHub backup.

## Reference

- [REST API](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/reference/api.md): the management API (/api/*).
- [Webhook contract](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/reference/webhook-contract.md): the exact HTTP contract for triggering workflows.
- [Partners](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/reference/partners.md): every partner configuration field.
- [Error handling](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/reference/error-handling.md): error classification, retries, fallback, alerts.
- [Observability](https://bidspoke.trypennie.dev/docs/reference/observability.md): the dashboard, tracing, alerts, cost, and retention.
